gary_2026_10_20_tech_x_market_decoders_r.title: Tech x Market Decoders - Reality Of Data Centers In Space
gary_2026_10_20_tech_x_market_decoders_r.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_20_tech_x_market_decoders_r.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together, salon-style with a small, curated group - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. Past attendees have been founders, investors & operators who work in tech or tech-adjacent roles across industries Our Why AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What AI cannot do is connect the dots around what's happening right now - a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. Or what a moment like that actually signals. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. If you want a space to actually grow your thinking IRL & connect with people who match that energy, this is it. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: Check-in & Intros 15 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech, the data. No talking, just thinking. 45 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up You'll leave with a sharper read on the topic than you walked in with, & a few new perspectives you hadn't considered. That's the whole point. This week's topic: The Reality of Data Centers in Space Starcloud just raised $250M to build satellites that run AI workloads in orbit, joining Google's "Project Suncatcher" & a SpaceX effort in a race to solve AI's power problem by moving compute off the planet entirely. The pitch is compelling - unlimited solar power, no water usage - but basic questions about heat dissipation, launch costs, & maintenance remain mostly unanswered. We're decoding: Is space-based computing a real solution to AI's real estate & energy issues? Supporting questions: What would actually have to be true for orbital data centers to beat a terrestrial one on cost? Who's positioned to win this race - the well-funded startups (Starcloud), or the hyperscalers who already have the capital & infrastructure (Google, SpaceX)? Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people. Prep not required but feel free to do some home research before you arrive if you'd like.

gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.title: Spooky Civic AI Hackathon - Build Weekend
gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_23_spooky_civic_ai_hackatho.summary: Gary's Guide: Demos are Sunday at Demo Day. RSVP for that separately: luma.com/3perce-pi2u Spooky Civic AI Hackathon: Build AI Tools for NYC Free. Open to everyone. No approval needed, just RSVP. Fri Oct 23 - Sat Oct 24, in person in NYC or on Zoom. Come solo & we'll help you find a team. Free food for in-person builders. Who can come? Anyone who wants to build something for New York City: engineers, product managers, designers, people who used to code, & people who never have. The best teams pair people who know a problem with people who can build the tech. Builders write the code & ship the tool. Problem-solvers (PMs, designers, policy & community folks) pick the problem, shape how people will use it, & lead the pitch. No team? No problem. Most people come solo. You can meet teammates at our Oct 14 & Oct 15 classes, or at Friday's kickoff. Pick a track The Existential Track: Climate & Sustainability. Heat, waste, food access, cleaner air. Urban Nightmares: Housing, Healthcare, Education & Justice. Tenant rights, benefits, school help, legal info in plain English. Ghost in the Machine: AI infrastructure & scaling. Build the parts under civic AI tools, like search, data, & agents that keep them running. Physical AI for Good: Build AI that moves, with robot arm kits on site. No robotics experience needed. You leave with a working prototype, a demo video, & a real project for your portfolio. Mentors will be on hand all weekend. Where: NYC venue announced soon. The Zoom link goes to everyone who RSVPs. Partners: Robot arm kits & on-site mentors from Viam. Food & builder API credits from Vonage. Costumes encouraged. In-person spots are limited, so RSVP now. Sponsorship inquiries: Partner with 3percentclub About Viam: Viam is a New York-based software platform for building, deploying, & managing robotics & AI in the physical world. Viam is supplying robot arm kits & on-site mentors for this hackathon. About Vonage: Vonage, part of Ericsson, builds communications APIs for voice, video, messaging, & verification that developers put into their apps. Vonage is providing food & builder API credits for this hackathon. About 3percentclub: 3percentclub is an NYC nonprofit that teaches free AI classes for underrepresented builders: engineers, career changers, product managers, designers, & people who have never coded. This event is open to everyone. Want to go deeper with AI? Apply to the free AI Architect Fellowship for weekly classes, mentorship, & a community to build with. The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 1,000,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 300+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. All attendees & organizers at events affiliated with The AI Collective agree to our privacy policy & are subject to our code of conduct.

jc_culture_10004845_2026_10_18_rent_the_.title: RENT: The Musical
jc_culture_10004845_2026_10_18_rent_the_.label: Music / Movies
jc_culture_10004845_2026_10_18_rent_the_.place: ART HOUSE, 345 MARIN BLVD, JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004845_2026_10_18_rent_the_.summary: Experience the groundbreaking Tony Award-winning musical and Pulitzer Prize-winning drama that defined a generation. Presented at Art House Productions during the 30th anniversary year of its original premiere, RENT follows a vibrant community of artists, musicians, and dreamers in New York City’s East Village as they pursue their passions, navigate love and loss, and strive to make a meaningful impact on the world around them. Set against the backdrop of the AIDS crisis, poverty, addiction, economic uncertainty, and a rapidly changing city, these artists discover the power of friendship, the importance of creative expression, and the enduring strength of community. Featuring iconic songs and an unforgettable rock score, RENT celebrates resilience, human connection, and the transformative role of the arts in times of hardship. This production is especially meaningful as part of Art House Productions’ 25th Anniversary Season. Founded in the wake of September 11, 2001, Art House was created to bring people together through the arts during a time of profound loss and uncertainty. Thirty years after its premiere, RENT remains as relevant, timeless, and inspiring as ever, reminding us all to measure our lives in love.

jc_culture_10003575_2026_11_04_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003575_2026_11_04_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003575_2026_11_04_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003575_2026_11_04_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_43584_2026_11_05_flame_the_ex.place: ART HOUSE, 345 MARIN BLVD, JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_43584_2026_11_05_flame_the_ex.summary: Flame (The Experience) for a one night only event presented by Ruby Hawk Productions and Art House Productions in Jersey City, New Jersey. Based on Brown’s 2021 poetry collection Flame, which tells the story of a failed twin flame romance, Flame (The Experience) takes the poetry off the page and brings it to life through a sizzling, multi-sensory theatrical experience told through sight, sound, monologues, and movement.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
